_doc: LADDER E2 (9 Aug 2026) — THE SCHEDULE'S EXPECTED SHAPE, snapshotted from the LIVE Task Scheduler after the ladder's D-phase landed (evening conductor + daemon watchdog + groundsman push + wake probe) and E6 deleted SelfKnowledge. The watchman diffs live schtasks against this nightly (probeExpectedTasks): an expected-enabled task MISSING is RED, an expected-disabled task ENABLED is a double-run WARN, an unlisted ArsenalFC-* task is an INFO (a new build not yet recorded here — update this file in the same commit that registers a task). Disabled is a DESIGNED state: the two conductors own those organs now; re-enabling one makes it race its chain.
